project.name: fplogin
project.tagline: Biometric Fingerprint Authentication for Linux Display Managers
project.target_v1: Arch Linux · systemd · SDDM 0.21.0 · fprintd / libfprint · Hyprland
project.latest_achievement: v1.0.0 accepted and closed (2026-11-25): sddm-fplogin 0.21.0-6 (Qt6 10/10 + Qt5 9/9, untouched legacy theme support, optional overlay & configurable retry key), fplogin-git (MIT, persistent config, real-host stock & no-SDDM installs PASS), Synaptics 06cb:00bd + hyprlock handoff verified, and 5-commit local upstream SDDM PR ready.
project.next_step: v1.0.0 complete. Optional future steps: submit local upstream SDDM PR when ready and sign external releases with GPG.

sprints.name: Foundation Gate

sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.subtitle: Core SDDM Integration: Concurrent Authentication Plumbing (Accepted)
sprints.goal: Patch SDDM v0.21.0 daemon and helper to run concurrent password and fingerprint helpers with atomic single-winner arbitration and guaranteed loser cleanup.

items.title: Patch 0001: Concurrent Authentication Methods
items.description: Added non-blocking concurrent PAM helper execution for password and fingerprint methods.

items.title: Dedicated PAM Service sddm-fingerprint
items.description: Isolated biometric PAM service leaving stock /etc/pam.d/sddm untouched.

items.title: Per-Request UUID IPC Correlation
items.description: Unique request UUIDs prevent stale or cross-request replies from opening sessions.

items.title: Dual-Helper Lifecycle Supervision
items.description: Clean helper supervision and reaping with zero zombie processes or leaked sensor claims.

items.title: Atomic Single-Winner Arbitration Gate
items.description: AuthAttemptGate guarantees only the first successful method acquires session authorization.

items.title: Immediate Losing-Helper Cancellation
items.description: Cancels and observes exit of the losing helper before authorizing the winner.

items.title: Winner-Only Deferred Session Authorization
items.description: Deferred PAM setcred/open_session executes exclusively for the single winning helper.

items.title: Autologin & Classic Password Preservation
items.description: Preserves 100% stock behavior for autologin and systems without biometric hardware.

items.title: R01: Active Concurrent Authentication
items.description: Verified concurrent password and fingerprint availability upon greeter focus.

items.title: R02: Password Wins While Reader Waits
items.description: Valid password opens session and cancels waiting biometric helper promptly.

items.title: R03: Fingerprint Wins With Pending Password
items.description: Fingerprint match opens session immediately and clears transient password input.

items.title: R04: Simultaneous Success Arbitration
items.description: Atomic gate serializes one winner and cleanly discards the second result.

items.title: R05: Fingerprint Cancel & Late-Success Rejection
items.description: Late responses after cancellation are discarded via request/generation validation.

items.title: R06: User Switch Invalidates Request
items.description: Switching target user cancels prior helpers and opens a fresh request identity.

items.title: R07: Session Switch Replaces Request
items.description: Switching desktop session updates target binding before session open.

items.title: R08: Unrecognized Finger, Timeout & Unavailable
items.description: Biometric errors report cleanly while password authentication stays unaffected.

items.title: R09: Display Teardown During Auth
items.description: Clean termination on display stop or systemctl stop sddm with zero leaked helpers.

items.title: R10: Fingerprint Failure & Bounded Retry
items.description: Bounded retries never block manual password entry.

items.title: R11: Password Failure & Continued Scan
items.description: Wrong password preserves active fingerprint verification in the same request.

items.title: R12: Password-Only Mode Without Reader
items.description: Zero biometric overhead or retry loops when no reader is present.

items.title: R13: Autologin Preservation
items.description: Configured autologin flows remain unaffected.

items.title: R14: Logind Session Reuse
items.description: Proper systemd-logind integration avoiding duplicate seats or orphan sessions.

items.title: R15: Logout / Relogin Freshness
items.description: Post-logout greeter starts with completely fresh state and request IDs.

items.title: R16: Account Policy Denial Recovery
items.description: PAM account/faillock denials block session open cleanly without locking up the greeter.
